implemented_adaptations.paper: Optimizing irrigation decisions with Seq2Seq modeling and deep reinforcement learning
implemented_adaptations.status: Independent transparent AGROLATTICE adaptation of forecast/state versus policy separation
implemented_adaptations.implementation: Existing FAO-style daily root-zone model + explicit Rainfed/RAW/deficit/fixed/sensor-threshold candidate strategies + seasonal water/event constraints + Pareto screening
implemented_adaptations.guardrail: No exact Seq2Seq/DRL claim and no irrigation-hardware control. NASA is historical/near-real-time gridded evidence, not future forecast.

implemented_adaptations.paper: Multiobjective spatial optimization of fertilizer rates enables sustainable crop production in southwest China
implemented_adaptations.implementation: Second-order N/P/K response surface + Ridge regularisation + grouped/K-fold validation + bounded exhaustive candidate grid + Pareto screening
implemented_adaptations.guardrail: Not exact NSGA-II; requires measured outcomes/rates and is bounded by local validation/support.

implemented_adaptations.paper: Developing remote sensing- and crop model-based methods to optimize nitrogen management in rice fields
implemented_adaptations.implementation: Single-state Gaussian update + independent time-varying paired prior/observation updates + recursive repeated-measurement update for static/calibration states, all with stored sequences/provenance
implemented_adaptations.guardrail: Not exact rice N workflow; evolving crop states are not recursively carried across time without a process-model prior, and no universal NDVI/EO-to-state mapping is assumed.

implemented_adaptations.paper: Evaluating Digital Tools for Sustainable Agriculture using Causal Inference
implemented_adaptations.status: Independent implementation of standard observational estimators motivated by the paper
implemented_adaptations.implementation: Cross-fitted propensity and outcome models; numeric/categorical pre-treatment covariates; explicit treated level; naive diagnostic, IPW, T-learner and AIPW-style effect; grouped bootstrap; overlap, balance, ESS and placebo diagnostics; persisted adjustment-rationale notes
implemented_adaptations.guardrail: Pre-treatment adjustment assumptions must be defensible; no estimator eliminates unmeasured confounding or substitutes for randomized/field experimental validation.
